label: Delimiter / first copy step in long sequences (L>=7)
explanation: Reset-gate unit 1 is active only at the start of the copy phase of long sequences: at the <DEL> step (recall_idx 0) when L>=7, and at the first copy step (recall_idx 1, input = first original token) when L>=8. In other words it fires when 6 or more outputs remain at the delimiter or the first copy step. Magnitude depends on length and position. The delimiter step carries 78% of the activation mass and is strongest for L=9 (top activations are all <DEL> at L=9, about 1.0 of max). The following first-copy step reaches about 0.3-0.6 of max. Rates rise with L (L=9 accounts for 65% of mass). Token identity matters little, with a slight rise when there are more digits. It never fires during the original-input phase, and almost never from recall_idx 2 onward or in short sequences (L<=6).

issues: The explanation says token identity 'barely matters', which is false at the first copy step. At recall_idx 1 with L=8 (dev split), the firing rate depends on in_tok (= orig(0)). It ranges from 0.4% for 'k', 1% for 's', 7% for 'a' and 8% for 'b' up to 88% for 'c', 93% for '0' and 95% for '1'. At L=9 it ranges from 15% for 'k' and 21% for 's' to 100% for 'c', '0' and '1'. The digit effect is just one piece of this per-token dependence.

The claim 'at the <DEL> step when L>=7' overstates L=7: only 52% of L=7 delimiter steps fire, against 93% at L=8 and ~100% at L=9. At L=7 the last original token (prev_tok) only moves the rate between about 30% and 79%, and no simple variable fully accounts for the remaining variation.

The claim 'at the first copy step when L>=8' overstates L=8: only 39% of recall_idx 1 steps at L=8 fire, and those cases are almost entirely set by the first original token. This cell is the main source of the predicate's 22k test false positives (precision 0.73).

The core structure holds: no activity in the original phase, delimiter carries 78% of the mass, a recall_idx 1 component is present, mass grows with L (L=9 holds 65%), and the unit is almost silent at recall_idx>=2 and L<=6. Test F1 0.822 and mass recall 0.985 reproduce.
skeptic.revised_label: Delimiter in long sequences (L>=8 reliably, L=7 about half the time), plus the first copy step at L>=8 gated by which token came first
